name: Yakovlev Yak-18T
summary: Four-seat Soviet-era trainer with a 360-hp M-14P radial and retractable tricycle gear, used by Aeroflot and flying clubs and now flown privately in the US.

wings: Low, tapered wing with rounded tips
Gear that folds into the wing
engines: Nine-cylinder M-14P radial in a round cowl
fuselage: Four seats under a long bubble canopy
Retractable tricycle gear with the nose wheel partly exposed
tail: Large swept fin with a dorsal fairing
Horizontal tail mounted on the fuselage

tellTales: Four-seat low-wing with a round radial nose and a long bubble canopy
Retractable gear with the nose wheel peeking out
Tall swept fin with a large dorsal fairing

confusedWith.howToTell: The Yak-52 is a two-seat tandem airplane with a smaller canopy; the Yak-18T is a four-seater with a longer canopy.
The CJ-6 is a two-seat tandem airplane with a smaller canopy; the Yak-18T has four seats.
The Cessna 182 is a high-wing; the Yak-18T is a low-wing with a radial.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
